data.definition: To give way to pressure, force, or superior authority.
data.grammar_rule: Inseparable verb requiring 'to' before the force surrendered to.
examples: The government refused to yield to terrorist demands.
Drivers must yield to oncoming traffic at the roundabout.
data.common_mistake: ❌ Yield for traffic on the left. ➔ ✅ Yield to traffic on the left.
